summary: Iteration 30: Successfully tested dashboard-in-profile migration and legal pages. All features working correctly - /dashboard redirects to /my-profile, Tarjetas tab shows full card dashboard (stats, grid/list toggle, CRUD actions), 4 legal pages load correctly, Settings includes Legal link.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 30 verified: /dashboard redirects to /my-profile (Navigate component), Tarjetas tab on MyProfilePage has stats (total/views/public), Nueva Tarjeta button (/cards/new), NFC button (/nfc/manage), grid/list toggle, card actions (view/QR/edit/share/delete). Legal pages: /legal (LegalHubPage with 6 sections), /cookies (CookiePolicyPage), /legal/community (CommunityGuidelinesPage), /legal/data-rights (DataRightsPage). Settings sidebar has 'Legal y Condiciones' link. BRUNO mascot logo visible in floating chat bubble.
